observed_in: Stealth and Awareness System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the various techniques players can use to achieve stealth, impacting how they can evade detection or manipulate enemy awareness. It varies by the methods available, such as hiding, distractions, or environment manipulation.
exclusion_criteria: Stealth that relies solely on character stats without tactical options
inclusion_criteria: Use of environmental cover for stealth
Mechanics for hiding in shadows or foliage
title: Stealth Methods Variation
